message: The other day, I was trying to check the weather updates before a big storm rolled in. Just as I settled in with my favorite mug of tea, my phone decided it was time for a nap—right in the middle of a weather alert! I ended up staring at the window, hoping for the best. It reminded me that while we rely on tech for info, it’s wise to have a backup plan, like a good old-fashioned battery-powered radio or a printed weather guide. What do you do when tech fails you?
